question: Should this PR wait for redacted Feishu or comparable production-runner proof before merge, or should maintainers accept the current source/test-only timing proof?
rationale: The code path is plausible and focused, but the reported user-visible failure is transport/runtime timing-sensitive and the PR changes session-state persistence behavior that focused tests do not fully settle.

options.title: Require production-path proof
options.body: Ask for redacted Feishu DM output or comparable OpenClaw runner logs showing the real tool result is persisted without a synthetic missing-result entry before merge.

options.title: Accept source-only timing risk
options.body: Maintainers may intentionally merge based on source and focused test evidence, while owning that the reported Feishu path was not proven on this head.

options.title: Pause behind the canonical issue
options.body: Keep this PR paused behind https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/issues/84134 until someone can produce real transport or production-runner proof.
